scale_policy: Building pieces and remaining prebuilt buildings use existing 0.7 architecture correction; all other props preserve source metres.
pivot_policy: Remove source display-grid translations; retain authored modular pivots; prebuilt buildings use ground-centred pivots.
source_formats: FBX and GLB are paired representations, not separate assets. Exact duplicate GLBs map to one runtime prefab; distinct texture variants remain distinct.
